body.x: SOMETECH(CEO Hee-Bong, Yang, www.sometech.com) showcased Industrial iMegascope 'IMS' that features Full HD System at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
An industrial Full HD device 'IMS' is video Imegascope system that features a variety of lenses from X340 to X3,400, which is used for industries, institutions and laboratories.

Mega Lens featuring excellent depth and resolution is capable of three-dimensional examination. Holding the camera on hands, focus adjustment can be done simply with a swiveling Knob and can be used for both contact/non-contact inspection without sampling process at a complete object.

Taken video may be easily saved on built-in memory or additional memory, so it does not need PC. The device can divide pictures into 16 splits to the maximum and has ability to compare and analyze them.

SOMETECH started up the business in 1989. As a technology-oriented venture company, for 24 years, it features software, optics, medicine and other industries based on a raft of application experiences.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
